Moonsea Ride (a.k.a. Mountain Ride in Co.src: FR Wiki: Moonsea Ride, Mistledale, Moonsea, Cormyr/Heartlands
Moonsea Ride (a.k.a. Mountain Ride in Co.note: CORRECTS THE TREE. This is ONE road Arabel->Hillsfar passing THROUGH the Dalelands, not the tree's two separate edges cormyr->dalelands and dalelands->moonsea. Tilverton is the Moonsea Ride / NORTHRIDE junction; Thunder Gap is a DIFFERENT route (Cormyr moved armies from Tilverton through Thunder Gap into the Dales). The tree's 'Tilverton/Thunder Gap' label conflates two routes. Terminus is Hillsfar specifically, not the moonsea region node. Starts at ARABEL, not Suzail - a Suzail->Arabel leg is missing entirely.

Dark Road.note: Shadowdale is a major AL location and is absent from the tree.

stops: Way of the Dragon (north from Suzail to the High Road)
Cormyr internal roads.src: FR Wiki: Cormyr/Heartlands (cites Volo's Guide to Cormyr p.123)
Cormyr internal roads.note: Alternates: Calantar's Way, Starwater Road (Immersea-Eveningstar), Immer Trail, Elclantar's Ride, Ranger's Way.

Western Moonsea triangle.note: Tesh Trail + the Throat + Bowshaft Way form this triangle. Bowshaft Way's eastern stretch links Yulash to Hillsfar. The River Tesh is the trade artery feeding the Black Road west - i.e. the Black Road's eastern approach is a RIVER leg, relevant to the medium system.

East Trail: Parnast (present) - Zelbross, Uluvin appear in route descriptions
ENTIRE ROAD MISSING: Blackford Road (Luskan -> Mirabar, 7 days) - not in the tree at all

east_cluster_finding.detail: The east cluster (Cormyr / Dalelands / Moonsea) has richly documented roads with ordered stops and named junctions, but not one cited distance was found on any of them. This is not a search failure - 2e/3e Cormyr and Dalelands products described their roads qualitatively. The west side has cited miles; the east side does not.
east_cluster_finding.implication: The 880-mi heartlands->cormyr connector cannot be replaced with a cited number, because no such number was ever published. It can only be replaced by measurement or by a declared house figure.

what_the_open_web_cannot_supply.why: The FR Wiki IS the aggregator. World Anvil, Realm of Adventure, Cathays, realmshelps and the Cormanthor wiki all reproduce the same wiki/sourcebook sentences with weaker citation. Searching wider returns the same text less well sourced, not new data.

three_ways_to_close_them.a_primary_sourcebooks: 2e Anauroch (1991), Volo's Guide to Cormyr (1995), The Moonsea (1995), Cormyr (1994), Volo's Guide to the North (1993). Copyrighted; not legitimately on the open web. If you own PDFs, upload them - same pipeline as the DDEX extraction. This is the real answer for the Black Road.
three_ways_to_close_them.b_map_measurement: AideDD's interactive map measures the official Schley maps against a printed scale. That is methodologically what Fonstad did - MEASUREMENT, not invention - and deserves its own provenance tag (`measured-map`), distinct from both `cited` and fan arithmetic. Your ruling whether to accept the grade.
three_ways_to_close_them.c_exchange_house_figures: Declared Exchange numbers, labelled as the Exchange's own per the house-rule standard. Never passed off as citations.
